Hissar Showroom Owner Dies by Suicide Amid Loan Pressure

An electronic showroom owner in Hissar died by suicide following alleged pressure from financiers. The family of the deceased has accused two financiers of demanding ₹25 lakh and threatening to kidnap their children if the money was not paid. One financier reportedly made 27 calls within an hour, with the suicide occurring 10 minutes after the last call. The deceased was reportedly under pressure due to a ₹20 lakh loan.
